pages.text: On a door's screen, turn on $(l)Parking garage$() and set its prices: an hour and a day.$(br2)Drivers pull up and press $(k:key.reikocars.hitch) to pay for 1 to 12 hours or 1 to 7 days, by card or cash, to you. The door then opens for their car, coming and going, until its time's up.

A car still inside when its time's up pays for the hours it's overstayed to get out. Your own cars park free, and anyone with a remote.$(br2)Parking garages are on the $(l:driving/gps)GPS$(/l), with their hourly price. An hour is a Minecraft hour (50 seconds), a day a Minecraft day.
